purpose: Preregistered opt-in Granite chunk-fairness candidate, same app-ready six-trial #174 workload
audio_source: tests/fixtures/2086-149220-0033.wav; short is one copy (7.435 s), long is ten copies (74.35 s), generated by tests/fixtures/make_fixtures.py
ws_connection_policy: Connect WS and require application ping/pong BEFORE starting HTTP; send short WAV after long queue_wait. Same readiness barrier for idle controls.
material_contention_rule: Baseline-only prereg rule; candidate harness verdict is expected inconclusive because a fair long job emits three request-service records and no busy replies. Use evaluate_fairness.py against the two six-trial JSON results.
reporting: Three matched serial/fair pairs only; exact finals and trace counts; no latency distribution claim. Preserve all failed attempts and host load.
amendment_1: After all app-ready serial baseline trials and before any fair-arm timing, candidate implementation fixed a continuation admission-slot race and removed an unnecessary runtime-mutex acquisition before short WS ticket entry. Candidate binary was rebuilt from commit 4121728 and rehashed. The six-trial sequence, audio, cores, readiness barrier and numerical comparison thresholds in fairness_comparison_spec.json are unchanged.
amendment_2: After the initial fair six-trial and A/B/A pilot passed, review identified a pre-load backend-identity cache bug and failure-path robustness gaps. Source commit bce8e389fd584ace2f345c8a3bc2270f134fb45b refreshes identity after model load, poisons failed jobs, hardens evaluators and the A/B/A runner, and replaces a completion-clock test with trace order. The candidate was rebuilt to this pinned SHA before final-binary replication. Baseline inputs, readiness, six-trial sequence, CPU affinity, and numerical thresholds in fairness_comparison_spec.json are unchanged. Initial results and their original specs remain committed; no attempt is discarded.
amendment_3: Before final-binary replication, reviewers found that a blocked streaming commit retried a terminal queue timeout with fresh deadlines and the evaluator used an amended spec for historical results. Source commit a3fd82279cd17262cb2c8398cf21fb0aff70ded6 propagates the terminal timeout and adds an explicit historical-spec option. The earlier attempt with source ad383d6 was interrupted after one idle trial and has no verdict; its partial result and interruption metadata are preserved in benchmarks/contention/results. The six-trial sequence, audio, readiness barrier, cores and numerical thresholds remain unchanged.
